youtube.title: Henry VIII got catfished by a painting. She took his castles 🏰 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Henry VIII fell for a portrait of Anne of Cleves. Then he met her. 🖼️😐

He annulled the marriage. She walked away with a palace and a castle.

Team Henry or Team Anne? Pick one 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on 1540: Henry married Anne of Cleves after seeing Holbein's portrait, said she looked nothing like it, and annulled the marriage after six months. Anne got Richmond Palace, Hever Castle, a big income and the title "the King's beloved sister".
